save_model_state_dict: save a PyTorch model state dict, optimizer, and stats to disk using save_model
load_model_state_dict: load a PyTorch model state dict, stats, and optimizer from disk using load_model
safe_save_model_atomic: safely save a model to disk using atomic temp directory moves via safe_save_model
find_last_checkpoint: find the last checkpoint file in an experiment directory using find_last_checkpoint
purge_epoch_checkpoint: delete all files for a specific epoch checkpoint using purge_epoch
